notes: Partly estimated, not measured on the Volvo: Fastned has no graph for the Volvo EX40/XC40 82 kWh (2023 - 2024) page (empty chargeGraph). The points are the Fastned Polestar 2 82 kWh (2023+) curve (400 kW charger class, 206 kW max, battery near 30 C, 6-100 %; peak 206.8 kW at 12 %, about 127 kW at 50 %, 60 kW at 73 %, 44 kW at 80 %). Volvo may use different software limits; replace when an EX40 test is found.

based_on.reason: Borrowed from the Fastned-measured Polestar 2 82 kWh (2023+) curve: both packs are 82 kWh gross / 79 kWh usable, NMC, 400 V (108s1p), and the 206.8 kW peak is within 5 % of the EX40 200-205 kW DC rating (EV Database lists a tested 207 kW on the EX40, consistent). Several EX40 and Polestar spec figures here are themselves estimated (82 kWh gross, 205 kW DC on four EX40 ids), and the motors and charging software are not shown to be shared, so the match is partly unproven and the curve figures are partly estimated.
